paraphrase: Four million three hundred twenty thousand solar years make a caturyuga, with the twilights and twilight-portions for each of Kṛta and the rest; a tenth of the yuga multiplied by four is Kṛta, by three Tretā, by two Dvāpara, by one Kali. Āryabhaṭa's statement that the four quarters of the yuga, Kṛta and the rest, are equal — not one of them agrees with what the smṛti says.
